# NeuralNg MeterGroup AI context

- Import canonical `NeuralMeterGroup` only from `@neural-ng/core/meter-group`.
- Do not generate the deprecated `MeterGroupComponent` compatibility alias.
- Use MeterGroup for scalar measurements in a known range, never task progress.
- Pass readonly NeuralMeterItem objects with label and numeric value.
- Optional item fields are color, iconClass, and valueText.
- Each item is an independently named role=meter with bounded numeric ARIA.
- min and max define the shared range. Invalid bounds and values are normalized.
- orientation controls horizontal or vertical meters.
- labelPosition is start or end; labelOrientation is horizontal or vertical.
- valueFormatter changes visible text only. Use item.valueText when assistive
  technology needs a more meaningful value description.
- Set unstyled for headless rendering. Meter semantics, structural hooks, and
  percentage sizing remain; NeuralNg visual classes are removed.
